gaql: SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, ad_group.id, ad_group_criterion.criterion_id, ad_group_criterion.keyword.text, ad_group_criterion.keyword.match_type, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.conversions, segments.date FROM keyword_view
notes: GA4 has no keyword *id* dimension — ads_mta_keyword_ids refuses.
metrics.conversions is Ads last-click (or Ads reporting), not GA4 DDA.
